items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he used to do have to shows for Ralph Burns and you know he was just doing a whole lot of music he didn’t like

ctx.x: I don’t know, I wrote a lot of things… I wrote some originals, I can’t remember a lot of the stuff I wrote. You know people mention them to me and it sort of comes back and I wonder if I wrote it or dreamt it. The strangest experience, maybe you’ve heard this from guys like Ralph Burns, is when you send an arrangement in and you never hear it played live… if you hear it played back years later, it’s the most eerie feeling in the world because you’re not sure if you wrote it or you dreamt it.
